# --instructions--

编写一个函数 `hasDuplicates(items)`，如果数组 `items` 中同一个值出现多次则返回 `true`，否则返回 `false`

# --before-seed--

```javascript
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
var _testFailedCount = 0;

var assert = require('assert')
const tryCatch = (...args) => {
  _testCount++
  try { assert(...args) }
  catch (e) {
    _testFailedCount++
    console.log(`Test Case '--err-t${_testCount}--' failed`);
  }
};
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --seed--

```javascript
function hasDuplicates(items) {

}
```

# --asserts--

`hasDuplicates([1, 2, 3, 2])` 必须返回 `true`。

```javascript
tryCatch(hasDuplicates([1, 2, 3, 2]) === true);
```

`hasDuplicates(["a", "b", "c"])` 必须返回 `false`。

```javascript
tryCatch(hasDuplicates(["a", "b", "c"]) === false);
```

`hasDuplicates([])` 必须返回 `false`。

```javascript
tryCatch(hasDuplicates([]) === false);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function hasDuplicates(items) {
  return new Set(items).size !== items.length;
}
```
